architecture.mechanism: Formal constraint specification using Object Constraint Language to define valid system states and enforce preconditions before state transitions
architecture.intervention: Define OCL constraints specifying the required valid memory and firmware states for the J794 module, then use a diagnostic interface to force the bricked module into a recovery bootloader mode where these formal constraints are evaluated prior to re-flashing, allowing the existing hardware to accept a clean firmware image without physical replacement
architecture.expected_effect: The J794 module exits the bricked state by satisfying the defined OCL preconditions during recovery, restoring full cabin instrumentation functionality on the current production hardware
architecture.falsification_test: Apply the OCL-constrained recovery procedure to a bricked J794 test unit and measure whether the module successfully boots to the infotainment home screen within 15 minutes; failure to boot or recurrence of the brick state falsifies the intervention
